finalMessage:
Implemented SHOP-57: eligible lines receive 5% off, rounded down per line, before discount codes. Combined discounts stay within 50%, and checkout charges the updated total.

Validation: all 42 tests pass; `ostf check --base main` reports 118 valid links.

Impacted items: `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`, `R-DISCOUNT-CAP`, `R-DISCOUNT-EXPIRY`, `R-TAX-RATE`, `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, `R-CHECKOUT-SESSION`.

Impact-listed tests passed:

- `Checkout`: places an order, needs a valid session, charges the volume-discounted total.
- `applyDiscount`: caps at fifty percent, rejects an expired code.
- `price`: taxes the subtotal after discounts.
- `tax`: rounds half up to the cent.
- `volume discount`: threshold, independent line rounding, code ordering and tax, combined cap, expired codes.

No new requirement IDs. Added links connect volume pricing and checkout to `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT`, pricing and its cap test to `R-DISCOUNT-CAP`, and the new expiry test to `R-DISCOUNT-EXPIRY`. Verified links were stamped using OSTF.
